name: @ankka/mcp-gateway
description: Customer-owned MCP gateway deployment kit for Ankka MCP Gateway.

scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build --workspace @ankka/gateway-installer
scripts.check: npm run check:toolchain && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:core && npm run test:apps && npm run check:boundary && npm run check:history
scripts.check:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspace @ankka/gateway-installer && npm run check:boundary && npm run build:admin && npm run test --workspace @ankka/gateway-admin && npm run test:core
scripts.plan:example: node src/cli.ts plan examples/gateway.config.json --observed examples/observed.empty.json --access examples/access-input.json
scripts.test: npm run build:admin && npm run test:core && npm run test:apps
scripts.test:payload: npm run build:admin && node --test test/release-payload-layout.test.mjs test/worker-primary-payload.test.mjs test/worker-uninstall-payload.test.mjs
